names.note: The calendar’s own name page for him is «Николай (Розов), протоиерей, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Николая … пресвитеров». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns THREE OTHER FOLDERS of the same stored form — `nicholas-rozov`, `nicholas-rozov-20-february` and `nicholas-rozov-7-march` — and the slug therefore carries the day, as `nicholas-rozov-20-february` already does.

death.note: The year the day line closes with, «(1938)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Николая и Алексия пресвитеров (1938).»

attestations.note: The first of the two one line names, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGES ARE ALL THERE IS. The line says «пресвитеров» and his name page «протоиерей», archpriest. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar’s twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries. A FOURTH FOLDER OF THIS NAME, AND THE READING IS THAT THEY ARE FOUR MEN: the corpus already keeps `nicholas-rozov` on the Julian 25 сентября with the year 1941, `nicholas-rozov-7-march` on 7 марта with 1930, and `nicholas-rozov-20-february` on 20 февраля with no year at all. This one is 10 декабря with 1938. Three of the four days and three of the four years differ, so three of them cannot be this man; THE 20 ФЕВРАЛЯ FOLDER HAS NO YEAR AND NOTHING IN EITHER SOURCE SAYS WHETHER IT IS HE, and that is left open rather than decided. The day page prints eleven hymns and none is under either name.
